summary: The references section shows good accuracy in citations but lacks consistency in format and style. There is a need for improved diversity in sources cited to enhance the breadth of perspectives. Addressing the formatting inconsistencies and ensuring compliance with style guides will significantly enhance the professionalism and credibility of the manuscript.
